title: Fewer calls: first establish the same result
goal: Compare two explicit queries with one batch selection using the same keys and 75 total.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P6. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: The new report makes fewer calls, but has it lost a request? Compare keys and values first, then discuss call count and observed time.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Convenient access can hide cost
paragraphs: A loop over 100 requests that reads the customer and rate can cause many individual calls. A short Клиент.Наименование expression does not prove negligible cost. Map data sources and count calls. One form may tolerate this; bulk reporting may benefit from a combined selection. Measurements decide.
Count calls to Execute in our own code: two per-reference queries versus one IN(&Keys). This is a local measured boundary, not a count of internal SQL statements, packets or cache reads.

sections.title: Continue your own P6 setup
paragraphs: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.

Use the existing Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги. Queries require no new permanent metadata object. Functions run in УчебныеДанные: Server and Server call enabled; Client/Global/Privileged disabled. Do not load a full CF over your work.

НовыйНаборРегистров is the P6 preparation helper. If already defined, retain its single definition and append only the new experience function. The Приложение.bsl caller belongs in the separate application handler. After one run, remove only the added startup call.

paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The worked example reads the same two references individually and in one query. Both yield 2 records/ 75 minutes. Two explicit Выполнить calls become one. This is not a count of internal SQL, cache, or network operations. The function returns millisecond fields, but this caller does not print them: no timings are guessed.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Freeze the baseline
paragraphs: Record version, volume, dataset, cold/warm state and measured operation. Network, cache and UI affect timing. Do not compare one cold baseline with a warmed new version. A small training infobase demonstrates method, not field p95 or industrial scaling.

Both paths use the same two references. One sums 30+45; the other returns 2/75. Check equivalence before timing. A professional larger comparison should also reconcile the complete key set and values by key.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: If the batched query loses a reference, may fewer calls establish an improvement?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. First require the same keys and values within the chosen measurement boundary. A coincidentally equal total does not replace the reference set. Fewer explicit calls do not guarantee every run is faster.

sections.title: Establish equivalence first
paragraphs: Replace per-item reads with a query selecting required fields and correct relationships. Compare identities, rows, missing values, sums and required order. Losing request-free customers can make a report faster but wrong. Keep a small oracle dataset beside the benchmark so optimization does not change the task.

Record platform wall-clock milliseconds without claiming monotonic time. Zero and an occasionally slower batch are legitimate for this tiny dataset; no assertion requires it to be faster every run. The explicit 2 → 1 reduction is separate from observed duration.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: This compares two paths over the same input, not four successive queries. The boundary starts after data preparation. Counting own Выполнить calls does not count every platform operation.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Omitting the third reference can return two rows sooner while solving a different task. The independent check requires all three references, three rows, and 120 minutes. Order is not promised without УПОРЯДОЧИТЬ.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Make two distinct conclusions
paragraphs: Report equivalence separately from call count and timing. Repeated runs reveal variability; one run is not p95. Unmeasured speedup remains a hypothesis. Do not enlargeNexusstartup budgets for the course; NEXUS-PERF-01 checks those independently.

For an optional study after the core task, use a new copy for a larger synthetic dataset, consistent conditions and at least five runs per variant. Retain raw timings, version and cache assumptions. These are not field p95 or a change to frontend NEXUS-PERF-01.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Prepare new own requests of 20, 40, and 60 minutes. Read the three references individually and in one query. Verify all exact keys and total 120. Print equivalence, explicit call counts 3 and 1, and total 120. These numbers establish neither milliseconds nor production p 95.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain the difference between own explicit calls, internal platform operations, and actual elapsed time.
